cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and known public details about Pdfroo.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF, annotate, sign, rearrange/merge pages, compress, find & replace, and download a real flattened PDF. **Nothing uploads**; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen in the browser (pdf.js + pdf-lib), and it works offline once loaded.

**Stack:** JavaScript, CSS, HTML (no build step, no backend, no install).  
**Responsive:** phones (375 px), tablets (768 px), desktops (1440 px+) — mouse, pen, or touch.  
**Live demo:** https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/  
**Repo:** https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo (MIT License)

Nice touches: drag-to-reorder thumbnails (SortableJS, touch-friendly), rotate/duplicate/delete/insert blank pages, merge by dropping PDFs onto the editor, light/dark theme, and a playful kangaroo toast on first successful download: *"Done! Your PDF never left your device. Go enjoy a coffee ☕"*
